limitations: The full enhancement goal remains active and incomplete; these are experimental candidates.
Actual PC storage UI, eggs and special summary contexts still require gameplay acceptance. PC-compatible box getter instruction tests do not prove the full PC UI flow.
Native Dark Cave lighting is verified; Ruins-of-Alph effects and remaining per-HM badge/story/animation/cancellation and transition/save acceptance remain pending.
These isolated project-created saves include an HG-derived SS fixture; they do not establish a fresh SS playthrough or general save interchangeability.

Final 14d runs import a native cartridge save containing declared earlier item/badge and temporary entry-routing fixture ancestry. Runtime L=A checks additionally change only the four-byte native input mode in isolated RAM.
L=A compatibility is checked through the native runtime input mode, not selection of the saved option through its Options UI. Native mapped-A delegation is separately covered by instruction tests.
Pre-final summary-14a and summary-14b prototype ROM runs are excluded from final candidate acceptance.
Cave/water visible encounters, legendary-roamer sprites, extended battle/bench evolution/move acceptance and other inventory features remain pending. No hardware or complete-release claim is made.
